task: Rewrite `test_w2_54_is_not_changed_by_this_ticket` so W1-28's and W1-50's whole-tree copy checks no longer count it as a whole-tree copy, without changing what it checks (DEC-385, DEC-977).
status: DONE. A one-line change to the skip message, committed as 6c8afc7fd29a; W1-28 and W1-50 are 28/28 green, and the W2-108 scope test still passes.
work_completed: I first reproduced the failure: 6 failed and 26 passed, the same 6 failures the lead reported. I then confirmed the lead's reading. In `w1_28_copy_check._analyse` (line 165), a call that mentions the root counts as a whole-tree route if any string in that call matches `_SHELL_ROUTE` (line 62). The f-string in the `pytest.skip` call contains `S.REPO_ROOT` and the words "git worktree", so it matched. I reworded the message so it no longer uses a route's words. The skip condition, the paths and both git assertions are unchanged. The README does not name the message, so it needed no update.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-108/test_w2_108_scope.py
evidence: Commit 6c8afc7fd29a "W2-108: the W2-54 scope test in DEC-385's form (W1-28's whole-tree check)", trailers: Task: DAEO-zoex; Role: independent-test-designer; Implements: DEC-385, DEC-977; Rewrite-Reason: DEC-385 (DEC-977); Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5. `git show --stat`: 1 file, 1 insertion, 1 deletion. `gov.__file__` = /home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-108-tests/src/gov/__init__.py.
tests: (1) W1-28 fixture copies plus W1-50 freeze fixture settings: 6 failed and 26 passed before the change, 28 passed after; no case is parametrised on the W2-108 test any more. (2) tests/acceptance/W2-108/test_w2_108_scope.py: 3 passed, including test_w2_54_is_not_changed_by_this_ticket. (3) tests/acceptance/W2-108 --collect-only: 27 tests collected, no error.
discoveries: W1-28's check flags this test wrongly (a false positive). At `tests/acceptance/W1-28/w1_28_copy_check.py:165` (`if whole and any(text in _ARGV_ROUTES or _SHELL_ROUTE.search(text) for text in _strings(node))`), every string anywhere in the call is searched, including the text of a message. So any `pytest.skip` or `assert` message that shows `REPO_ROOT` next to a word such as "git worktree", "rsync", "tar c…" or "cp -r" reads as a copy. I did not change it.
risks: A later edit that puts a route's words back into this message next to the root would turn the checks red again. The check's own failure message would make that easy to diagnose.
lessons: In acceptance tests, keep `REPO_ROOT` out of any message that contains git, rsync, tar or cp route words, at least until W1-28's check ignores message text. Inside the sandbox, `git status` shows dotfiles (.bashrc, .gitconfig, .mcp.json, .idea, .vscode and others) as untracked. They are /dev/null character devices (1,3) the sandbox puts there, not files; the tracked tree is clean.
proposed_decisions: One package, P2, owner W1-28's area. W1-28's check should skip the text of message arguments (`pytest.skip`/`pytest.fail` arguments and `assert` messages), or look for route words only in argv-style lists and in calls to `subprocess` or `os.system`. That would remove this kind of false positive. Recommendation: defer; it is not needed for W2-108. Confidence: medium.
unresolved: none
recommended_next_action: The lead re-runs W2-108's close, together with W1-28's and W1-50's checks, at the integration head with commit 6c8afc7fd29a.

**Sandbox check:** (a) the write failed with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`, as required. (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both worked (exit 0). GOV_ROLE, GOV_TICKET, the worktree path and the branch all matched what the brief expects.

**Commit:** 6c8afc7fd29a

**The diff:** only the message of the skip call changed. `"{REPO_ROOT} is not a git worktree"` became `"{REPO_ROOT} has no .git: this ticket's history cannot be read there"`. The condition (`not (S.REPO_ROOT / ".git").exists()`), the paths (W2-54's tests and the two context-check declarations), the `git log --no-merges --grep=^Task: DAEO-zoex$ -- <paths>` assertion and the `git status --porcelain -- <paths>` assertion are all unchanged. I chose this over a module-level function with `root=REPO_ROOT` because the test copies nothing. That form would make the check run it as a copier, and it would produce no copy.

**Runs:** 6 failed / 26 passed before the change and 28 passed after (W1-28 and W1-50); 3 passed (W2-108 scope); 27 collected (W2-108).
